definition: an elevated slope of ground, a hillside
description: A single skier is a tiny dark figure high on a huge, smooth, untouched snow face under a deep blue sky. He skis down the long incline, throwing up a bright plume of powder snow behind him. The camera pulls back and the whole snow face is revealed dropping away at a steep angle from the ridge at the top all the way down towards the water, with snowy mountain peaks and a fjord catching the low orange sun on the far side.

de.answer: Er fährt auf Skiern einen steilen Hang hinunter.
